Subject: Possible event observed — request for IRP + telemetry

Hi Dylan,

We're seeing elevated error rates and anomalous token-usage patterns from calls that appear to be coming from your account (FinOps Prod API key). Our security team flagged a subset of traces that look like repeated failed auth attempts followed by successful sessions from a small number of IPs.

Can you please confirm whether this was an expected behavior from a rollout on your side, or if you can share your incident response plan (IRP) and any relevant telemetry extracts? For our SOC2/ SIG review we need:

- Confirmation whether this is an internal change or potential compromise
- A copy of your IRP section that covers detection and containment (redacted as needed)
- Telemetry extracts for the affected timeframe (2026-11-14 00:00 — 2026-11-14 08:00 PST)

If this is an incident on your side, we'll need a short timeline and your point of contact for the next 48 hours. We're on a tight audit window and would like to keep this documented.

Thanks — please reply to this thread.

Nora
Nora Patel

- redwood_ir_evidence_20261114.zip (contains sanitized logs, access logs, and the IR checklist)

- At 01:34 PST, there were a small number of successful sessions that correlate with a single client_id. We are validating whether those were legitimate refreshes or token re-issuances.

For the immediate ask:
- My point of contact for the next 48 hours is me (Dylan). Mobile: +1-415-555-0104.
- We're preparing a short IR timeline and will share an internal, redacted copy of the IRP section that covers detection/containment by EOD.

Marissa, assigning to you to validate the redaction for the IRP before we share with FinOps (SOC2-safe). Karthik — please preserve all related telemetry slices and mark them for retention per our SOC2 evidence policy.

I'll follow up with a consolidated timeline and the redacted IRP.

Thanks,

Hi Nora,

Thanks for the report and for flagging the evidence window. We received your notification and have completed a quick triage. We have:

1) Placed a retention hold on all matching telemetry and access logs (owner: Karthik Iyer).
2) Prepared a redacted IRP excerpt focused on Detection, Containment, and External Communication (attached and uploaded to the shared folder).
3) Created a short timeline of events (below) and a recommended 48-hour action plan.

Event timeline (sanitized):
- 2026-11-14 01:13–01:22 PST: repeated failed auth attempts from ephemeral IPs — automatic invalidation triggered
- 2026-11-14 01:34 PST: small number of successful sessions correlated to client_id XZ-742 (under investigation)
- 2026-11-14 02:00 PST: internal alert fired; triage started
- 2026-11-15 09:00 PST: key rotation completed for affected keys; no further anomalies detected

Deliverables shared:
- Redacted IRP excerpt: redwood_IRP_redacted_20261116.pdf (uploaded)
- Evidence bundle: redwood_ir_evidence_20261114.zip (previously attached)
- Telemetry extract link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cIR-evidence

Next steps / proposed timeline:
- 24 hours: FinOps to confirm whether the supplied artifacts satisfy the SIG evidence requirements for this audit window.
- 48 hours: optional working call to review artifacts (we're available 2026-11-17 10:00–14:00 PST).
- 7 days: final sanitized postmortem with AAR and mitigation items.

If FinOps needs a notarized attestation or additional cryptographic hash of the evidence bundle for chain-of-custody, let us know and we'll route to Legal.

Regards,
